title: Orders per customer
statement:
Tables customers(id, name) and orders(id, customer_id, total).

For every customer, return their name and how many orders they placed, including customers with no orders (count 0). Sort by order count, highest first, then by name. Orders whose customer_id matches no customer are ignored.

No orders yet
Ties
200 customers
